correctness.rationale: PASS: In the order-(k−1) binary de Bruijn digraph, two extra arcs must themselves be balanced: two loops (00…0 and/or 11…1), or the unique alternating directed two-cycle. With a unique anchoring arc, BEST counts indistinguishable parallel edges. Three loop cases contribute B_k=2^(2^(k−1)−k) each. For alternating pair, determinant lemma on the de Bruijn Laplacian and P^(k−1)=Π give ratio 1+∑_{j=0}^{k−2}(−1/2)^j=5/3+(−1)^k/(3·2^(k−2)). Thus four exact type counts and total B_k(3+R_k) for every k≥2. Independent exhaustive cyclic-word enumeration gave 5,9,76 for k=2,3,4; independent exact reduced-Laplacian determinants k=2..7 reproduced ratios 2,3/2,7/4,13/8,27/16,53/32.
